'''Zaff's Superior Staffs''' is a staff shop located near central [[Varrock]], owned by [[Zaff]]. It is the main source of [[battlestaves]] and of [[elemental staves]] for [[free player]]s.

In [[Deadman Mode]], battlestaves will restock in '''1 tick''' instead of 100 ticks.

==Varrock Diary discount perk==
Players who have completed tiers of the [[Varrock Diary]] may buy noted [[Battlestaff|battlestaves]] at a discounted price of 7,000 coins each once per day from the [[Barrel (Zaff's Superior Staffs!)|barrel]] on the {{FloorNumber|uk=0}} of the shop. The number of staves available depends on the player's progress in the Varrock Diary.

Buying discounted [[Battlestaff|battlestaves]] is a good daily moneymaking method, as players can immediately sell them on the [[Grand Exchange]], where they usually go for over 8,000 coins each. The current price of a [[Battlestaff|battlestaff]] is {{Coins|{{GEP|Battlestaff}}}}. Players can also choose not to sell them and use them to train [[Crafting]] by making [[elemental battlestaves]], which is especially useful for [[Ironmen]].

==Trivia==
*Laying on the northern table inside the shop, there appears to be a [[Pharaoh's sceptre]], a [[Slayer's staff]], and a [[rod of ivandis]]. Additionally, against the wall are some staves with heads similar to that of [[Ahrim's staff]]. However, Zaff does not sell any of these in his shop.
